rule: Carry the recognizable character/object from inspected independent game recordings into the adjacent explanation. Attach symbols to it or explicitly map its simplified representation. A screenshot animation is an illustration, never a game measurement.

choices.choice: Keep spheres, surface/joint experiments and essential mathematical geometry; replace unrelated stand-ins and map the actual-game subject to its representation.
choices.reason: A Mario screenshot cannot replace a calculated surface normal or a control point.

choices.choice: New masters on C with the existing D review hub linking to them.
choices.reason: D has about 4.5 GiB free. C has about 22 GiB. Preserve all existing media.

choices.choice: Use fresh v4 work/output paths and preserve all v3 drafts.
choices.reason: Exact first-frame QA found one-frame old stand-ins; correct activation tolerance and force callout occlusion consistently before final rendering.

choices.choice: Keep new generated render work and QA cache on C as well as final MP4s.
choices.reason: D has about2GiB free and the user has an unrelated Unity build; preserve existing media and leave that build untouched.

choices.choice: Encode Clean and captioned outputs from the same composite on NVENC, then preserve original audio packets by remux.
choices.reason: Preserve captioned picture quality with one composite encode; proven60fps grid and exact first-frame output; keep disk usage bounded without touching prior masters.
